The '''K-57CE engine''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] engine produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The K-57CE's gravity capacitors and maneuvering thrusters were specially-calibrated for the "snap turn" defensive maneuver, allowing pilots to perform 180-degree snap turns in seconds.
